caption:
Payment history is the biggest piece of a FICO Score, about 35%.
That means one boring habit beats most tricks: pay on time, every time.
Autopay for the minimum is a safety net, not a plan to stop there.
What's one bill you've automated that saved you stress?
first_comment: Which bill did you automate first? 👇

card.headline: On-time payments are the biggest piece of your score
card.sub: Automate the minimum as a safety net
